name: Awesome DS
description: Awesome DS is a token-driven design-system showcase built on Web Awesome 3.12 and Font Awesome Free 7.3.1: 70 typed React component wrappers, 2,883 searchable icons, semantic design tokens, and light/dark themes with a live theme editor. Static, read-only site — no APIs.

skills.name: Browse design foundations
skills.description: Explore the system's design tokens: semantic color tokens and palettes (/colors), typography — font families, sizes, and weights (/typography), and spacing, radius, and shadow tokens (/scale).

skills.name: Browse components
skills.description: Catalog of all 70 components with live examples and usage guidance (/components).

skills.name: Browse icons
skills.description: Searchable index of 2,883 Font Awesome Free icons — search with /icons?q=<term> (/icons).

skills.name: Read delivery and integration guidance
skills.description: How to consume the system in a project: bundle, CDN, and server-side-rendering options (/delivery), plus open-source credits and license terms (/licenses).
